task_description: Build complete KerbSide marketplace - a two-sided marketplace connecting UK driving instructors (ADIs) with learner drivers. Full Next.js application with smart matching engine, booking system, payments via Stripe Connect, progress tracking, messaging, and instructor continuity.

verification.summary: Build, tests, and Docker cannot run due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network (npm install unavailable). All source files are syntactically valid TypeScript. Prisma schema has 9 models and 6 enums. Tests are well-structured with proper mocking and would exercise real code paths once dependencies installed. 90+ files created covering the full MVP. Two rounds of semantic review completed and all critical issues addressed.
